sections.presenting_complaint: Vomiting and diarrhoea in a 10-month-old since last week.
sections.history: About five non-bilious, milky vomits since last night, fewer today. Six to seven loose stools today. No blood in Freya's stools (her brother had blood in his stool with a similar illness last week). Two wet nappies since this morning (initially said four). Taking small amounts of breast milk and formula. Temperature 37.4 °C. Alert and playing. Not drowsy or floppy. No rash. Previously well.
sections.medications_allergies: No regular medications. No known drug allergies.
sections.examination: Mucous membranes moist; anterior fontanelle not sunken.
sections.impression: Probable viral gastroenteritis with reduced urine output.
sections.plan: No face-to-face review needed. Continue breastfeeding; oral rehydration solution in small, frequent amounts.
sections.safety_netting: Call 999 if floppy, very sleepy, hard to wake, or non-blanching rash. Attend A&E if green vomit or blood in stool.
